name: io.github.zachshallbetter/adobe-mcp-premiere
title: Premiere Pro MCP Server
description: Drive Adobe Premiere Pro from any MCP client: projects, sequences, timeline edits, effects, export.

environmentVariables.name: PREMIERE_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port on 127.0.0.1 the Premiere Pro plugin connects to. Default 3011; set the same port in the plugin panel

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared secret the plugin must send to connect (enter it in the plugin panel). PREMIERE_BRIDGE_TOKEN overrides it

environmentVariables.name: PREMIERE_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories allowed for file operations (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: PREMIERE_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for Premiere Pro before reporting that a dialog may be open. Default 120000

environmentVariables.name: PREMIERE_CONNECT_WAIT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long a call waits for the plugin to connect before failing. Default 4000
